summary: In this excerpt, the narrator and Halliday, locked in a room, plan to start a fire using the proof papers, mathematical journals, and furniture so that the guards cannot recover the proof. The narrator reasons through combustion and ventilation, breaks the chair and table, keeps a table leg as a weapon, and builds a pyre. Halliday, skeptical, is told to scream about fire when the next food tray arrives and to get down by the food slot.
one_line: The narrator and Halliday plan to burn the proof and furniture in their locked room before the next food tray arrives.
key_facts: The narrator reasons that burning everything that combusts well would make the fire big enough to keep the mathematics out of the guards' hands.
Halliday says the plan is madness, but the narrator refuses to back out.
The next food tray arrives only a handful of seconds after three.
The narrator estimates about a two minute window before the fire becomes dangerous for them.
The narrator smashes the chair against a concrete wall so its joints snap apart and its legs clatter to the floor.
The narrator brings the proof papers and mathematical journals to the side of the room farthest from the door and folds them into a bonfire tower.
The narrator levers one end of the table up and slams it against the wall, despite torn muscles.
The narrator keeps one table leg as a weapon, judging its balance and center of mass good for a swing.
The narrator stacks the remaining wood around the papers to build a pyre.
Halliday tells the narrator that they are injured and suggests waiting a few days for a better way.
The narrator says 'Too late now' and checks his watch, noting that starting the fire early might kill them.
The narrator instructs Halliday to scream about fire the minute the food arrives and to be ready to get down by the food slot.
Halliday reluctantly stands by the door and obeys.
The narrator states that he is getting Halliday out, not getting her killed.

entities.name: Halliday
entities.role: companion of the narrator in the locked room, who objects to the fire plan and is told to raise the alarm when the food tray arrives

entities.name: the narrator
entities.role: first-person speaker who devises and executes the plan to burn the proof and furniture

entities.name: the guards
entities.role: captors who will bring the food tray and may try to recover the proof or extinguish the fire

entities.role: mathematical proof papers the narrator intends to burn so the guards cannot recover them
